text_en: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff, and I was told, “Come and measure the temple of God and the altar and those who worship there,
text_cn: 然后给了我一根长芦苇，当作测量杖说：“你起来，去测量天主的圣殿和祭坛，计算在殿内朝拜的人！

text_en: but do not measure the court outside the temple; leave that out, for it is given over to the nations, and they will trample over the holy city for forty-two months.
text_cn: 圣殿外面的庭院要除外，不要测量，因为已交给了异民；他们必要践踏圣城，共四十二个月。

text_en: And I will grant my two witnesses authority to prophesy for one thousand two hundred sixty days, wearing sackcloth. ”
text_cn: 可是，我要打发我的两位证人，穿着苦衣，做先知劝人，共一千二百六十天。”

text_en: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
text_cn: 这两位就是立在大地的主宰前的那两棵橄榄树，和那两座灯台。

text_en: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire pours from their mouth and consumes their foes; anyone who wants to harm them must be killed in this manner.
text_cn: 假使有人想谋害他们，必有火从他们的口中射出，吞灭他们的仇人；所以谁若想谋害他们，必定这样被杀。

text_en: They have authority to shut the sky, so that no rain may fall during the days of their prophesying, and they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every kind of plague, as often as they desire.
text_cn: 他们具有关闭上天的权柄，以致在他们尽先知任务的时日内，不叫雨下降；对水也有权柄，能使水变血；几时他们愿意，就能以各种灾祸打击大地。

text_en: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the bottomless pit will make war on them and conquer them and kill them,
text_cn: 当他们一完成了自己作见证的职分，那从深渊中上来的巨兽，要同他们作战，且战胜他们，杀死他们。

text_en: and their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city that is prophetically called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
text_cn: 他们的尸体要被抛弃在大城的街市上──这城的寓意名字叫作索多玛和埃及，他们的主子也曾在此地被钉在十字架上──

text_en: For three and a half days members of the peoples and tribes and languages and nations will gaze at their dead bodies and refuse to let them be placed in a tomb;
text_cn: 由各民族、各支派、各异语、各邦国来的人，要观看他们的尸体三天半之久，且不许把他们安葬在坟墓里。

text_en: and the inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and celebrate and exchange presents, because these two prophets had been a torment to the inhabitants of the earth.
text_cn: 地上的居民必要因他们的死而高兴欢乐，彼此送礼，因为那两位先知实在磨难了地上的居民。

text_en: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and those who saw them were terrified.
text_cn: 过了三天半，由天主来的生气进入了他们身内，他们就立足站了起来，凡看见的人，都起了大恐怖。

text_en: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here! ” And they went up to heaven in a cloud while their enemies watched them.
text_cn: 以后，他们二人听见从天上来的大声音向他们说：“上这里来罢！”他们遂乘着云彩升了天，他们的仇人也看见了。

text_en: At that moment there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell; seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
text_cn: 正在那个时辰，发生了大地震，那城倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的人就有七千名；其余的人都害怕起来，就归光荣于天上的天主。

text_en: The second woe has passed. The third woe is coming very soon.
text_cn: 第二个灾祸过去了；看，第三个灾祸快要来了。

text_en: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign forever and ever. ”
text_cn: 第七位天使一吹号角，天上就发出大声音说：“世上的王权已归属我们的上主，和他的基督，他要为王，至于无穷之世！”

text_en: Then the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
text_cn: 那在天主前坐在自己宝座上的二十四位长老，遂俯伏在地，朝拜天主，

text_en: singing, “We give you thanks, Lord God Almighty, who are and who were, for you have taken your great power and begun to reign.
text_cn: 说：“上主，全能的天主！今在，昔在者！我们称谢你，因为你取得了你的大权，登上了王位。

text_en: The nations raged, but your wrath has come, and the time for judging the dead, for rewarding your servants, the prophets and saints and all who fear your name, both small and great, and for destroying those who destroy the earth. ”
text_cn: 异民发了怒，可是你的震怒也到了，就是审判死者，赏报你的众仆先知、圣徒，以及敬畏你名字的大者小者的时候到了，并且也到了消灭那毁坏大地之人的时候。”

text_en: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen within his temple; and there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and heavy hail.
text_cn: 那时，天主在天上的圣殿敞开了，天主的约柜也在他的圣殿中显出来了；紧接着便有闪电、响声、雷霆、地震和大冰雹。
